shots.image_prompt: Dark stormy grey sky, heavy rain, wet city street with puddles and reflections. shots.image_prompt: Bright blue sky with a big cartoon sun, hot cracked dry desert ground, sand dunes far away. Left: {hero} walking, holding the same red umbrella upside down full of water, a metal water tap fixed under it, filling a small metal mug, happy smile. Right: {rival} bent over, exhausted, sweating, tongue hanging out, very thirsty.
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera. The green-shirt stickman fills the mug from the tap, drinks and smiles happily. The blue-shirt stickman sweats, tears fall, he drops to his knees and then falls flat on the ground. Heat haze shimmers. Smooth 2D cartoon animation, consistent characters.
